import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path

source = Path(".cuga/env/testbed/data/order_summary.xlsx")
output_dir = Path("order_summary_csv")
output_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

# Export every worksheet to a separate CSV file.
worksheets = pd.read_excel(source, sheet_name=None)

for sheet_name, table in worksheets.items():
    safe_name = "".join(
        character if character.isalnum() or character in "-_" else "_"
        for character in sheet_name
    )
    table.to_csv(
        output_dir / f"{safe_name}.csv",
        index=False,
        encoding="utf-8-sig",
    )

print(f"Exported {len(worksheets)} worksheet(s) to: {output_dir.resolve()}")
